thread:
alana: Quick idea  semi-final watch party + taco potluck Friday? small fantasy MVP prop bet too :taco:

rene: tacos yes. also down for a tiny MVP prop: guess first goal scorer. $3 to the winner? :money_with_wings:

todd: I'll bring guac and chips. @alana can you reserve the kitchen TV? Also heads-up: our keeper draft window opens Saturday, FYI.

faye: :raised_hands: tacos, guac, and yes to the prop bet. putting $3 in the winner jar. Also i can stream a mock draft at lunch if anyone wants practice for the keeper picks.

alana: Kitchen TV reserved at 7pm. Kickoff 7:45pm. Prop rules: guess first scorer before kickoff, closest gets pot. If multiple correct, split.

draft-bot: Announcement: Keeper draft window opens Sat 09:00, closes Sat 17:00. Remember to submit keeper declaration before the window closes.

rene: Quick keeper rule question: can you trade a keeper and keep them next season?

todd: No, if traded they lose keeper designation for next season unless both managers agree during keeper declaration window. Standard house rule.

faye: Also tiny side challenge: best halftime chant gets office sticker pack. No rehearsal allowed. Crowd vote via reactions at halftime.

alana: Poll for food: react :one: tacos, :two: pizza, :three: both. I'll order based on majority.

emoji-bot: emoji reaction suggestion: :one: :two: :three:

rene: :one: tacos. (i will fight for spicy salsa)

todd: :three: both. compromise hero.

faye: :one: tacos please. Also draft practice at lunch Tue if anyone wants to run mock keepers.

alana: Mock draft sign-up: reply here or DM. Also reminder: please label dishes and clean the counter after.

rene: tiny bet update: if prop bet loser has to wear a rival team bandana for a day, okay? :thinking:

todd: fine by me. holder of the bandana must also bring donuts Monday. Deal.

faye: Deal. Also i'll bring napkins and a small bell for dramatic moments.

draft-bot: Quick tip: use the keeper multiplier sheet before you lock in picks. Link: https://docs.example/keeper-multiplier

alana: Great. See you Friday night 7:15 for food drop-off, 7:40 seating. May the best guesser win (and may the guac survive).
